invoice_number.definition: Printed identifier of this invoice; not an original invoice linked by a note.

invoice_type.definition: Printed invoice or credit/debit-note type wording; not AP/AR or review status.

invoice_reference.definition: Separately printed invoice reference other than its primary invoice number.

supplier_name.definition: Invoice seller/issuer name; carries no AP/AR direction.

supplier_address.definition: Printed address of the invoice seller, preserving all supplied address lines.

customer_name.definition: Printed buyer/customer name; carries no AP/AR direction.

customer_address.definition: Printed customer/buyer address; not automatically billing or service address.

invoice_date.definition: Issue date printed for this invoice; not due, service, payment or upload date.

due_date.definition: Explicit printed payment due date; do not calculate it from payment terms.

currency.definition: Unambiguously printed currency normalized to a three-letter code; otherwise null.

subtotal.definition: Printed subtotal in its labelled scope; do not derive tax-exclusive total.

tax.definition: Printed document-level tax amount, distinct from each category or item tax and tax rates.

total.definition: Printed document grand total; never substitute amount due, sales, tender or payment.

discount.definition: Printed document-level discount amount, not a rate or a sum inferred from item discounts.

supplier_registration_id.definition: Printed seller business-registration identifier, distinct from tax identifiers.

supplier_tax_id.definition: Printed seller tax identifier with no more specific supported tax scheme; do not duplicate TIN or SST labels.

customer_registration_id.definition: Printed customer business-registration identifier, distinct from tax identifiers.

customer_tax_id.definition: Printed customer tax identifier with no more specific supported tax scheme; do not duplicate TIN or SST labels.

purchase_order_number.definition: Printed purchase-order identifier; not a contract, invoice or delivery reference.

contract_reference.definition: Printed identifier of an associated contract.

delivery_reference.definition: Printed delivery-note/shipment reference; do not infer a goods-receipt record.

payment_terms.definition: Printed terms of payment as text; do not convert them to a due date without that date being printed.

payment_instructions.definition: Printed payment instruction text, distinct from the separately labelled account and method fields.

payment_reference.definition: Printed reference for a payment/transaction; not evidence of settlement by itself.

payment_method.definition: Printed payment method text; do not infer paid/approved status.

payment_bank_name.definition: Printed bank named in invoice payment instructions, not a customer or utility account provider.

payment_account_number.definition: Printed bank account in invoice payment instructions; preserve leading zeros.

billing_address.definition: Explicitly labelled billing address; do not copy a generic customer address into this field.

shipping_address.definition: Explicitly labelled ship-to address, distinct from billing and customer addresses.

allowance_total.definition: Explicit printed document allowance total; not an inferred discount sum.

charge_total.definition: Explicit printed invoice document charge total, excluding unrelated bill balances.

tax_exclusive_total.definition: Explicit total excluding tax; do not alias a generic subtotal.

tax_inclusive_total.definition: Explicit total including tax; keep distinct from grand total.

prepaid_amount.definition: Printed advance/prepayment amount, distinct from paid amount.

paid_amount.definition: Printed invoice paid amount; not an accounting settlement status.

amount_due.definition: Printed balance requested for payment; distinct from total and previous balance.

rounding.definition: Printed signed monetary rounding adjustment; no rounding is introduced by annotation.

service_start_date.definition: Printed start date of the service interval at document or item scope.

service_end_date.definition: Printed end date of the service interval at document or item scope.

delivery_date.definition: Printed actual delivery date at document or item scope; not a received/upload timestamp.

payment_date.definition: Explicit printed date of a payment; not inferred from issue date or payment method.

myinvois_uuid.definition: Printed UUID assigned to this e-invoice; not the supplier invoice number or original invoice UUID.

myinvois_long_id.definition: Printed MyInvois long identifier, kept distinct from the invoice UUID.

myinvois_validation_reference.definition: Separately labelled validation reference; do not duplicate a UUID or long ID here.

myinvois_qr_payload.definition: Exact payload independently decoded from a printed QR code; evidence must identify that code.

supplier_tin.definition: Explicitly identified seller TIN; do not also count it as a generic supplier_tax_id.

customer_tin.definition: Explicitly identified buyer TIN; do not also count it as a generic customer_tax_id.

supplier_sst_id.definition: Explicitly identified seller SST registration identifier, distinct from TIN and company registration.

customer_sst_id.definition: Explicitly identified buyer SST registration identifier, distinct from TIN and company registration.

supplier_msic_code.definition: Printed seller business-classification code, kept as text including leading zeros.

supplier_business_activity.definition: Printed seller business-activity description, not a model-inferred industry.

credit_note_number.definition: Printed identifier of this credit note; invoice_number is reserved for invoice documents.

debit_note_number.definition: Printed identifier of this debit note; invoice_number is reserved for invoice documents.

original_invoice_number.definition: Printed number of an earlier invoice referenced by this document; not this document number.

original_invoice_uuid.definition: Printed UUID of an earlier linked invoice, distinct from its invoice number.

note_reason.definition: Printed reason for a credit/debit note or adjustment, without inferred accounting treatment.

industry_reference.definition: Printed industry-specific reference with its original label retained in printed_text.

myinvois_validation_datetime.definition: Printed timestamp preserved as text, including timezone if printed.

bill_number.definition: Printed primary bill identifier; do not duplicate a generic bill reference unless separately printed.

bill_reference.definition: Printed generic bill reference; a bill-number alias needs printed-role confirmation.

provider_name.definition: Printed issuer/provider of the bill; carries no AP/AR or settlement inference.

provider_address.definition: Printed address of the bill issuer/provider, not the customer service location.

bill_date.definition: Printed bill issue date; not due date or billing-period boundary.

customer_account_number.definition: Printed customer/service account with the bill provider; not a bank payment account.

service_address.definition: Explicit printed address where the billed service is supplied.

billing_period.definition: Complete printed billing-period text; start/end dates are separately normalized components when supported.

meter_number.definition: Printed meter identifier at document or repeated-meter scope; no value for documents without a meter.

consumption_unit.definition: Printed unit for measured usage, preserving the source notation.

tariff_name.definition: Printed tariff/plan name; not a numeric rate or an inferred service category.

billing_period_start.definition: Start date supported by an unambiguous printed billing interval; never derived from bill date.

billing_period_end.definition: End date supported by an unambiguous printed billing interval; never derived from due date.

previous_reading_date.definition: Printed date associated with the previous meter reading.

current_reading_date.definition: Printed date associated with the current meter reading.

previous_reading.definition: Printed previous cumulative meter reading; not previous-period consumption.

current_reading.definition: Printed current cumulative meter reading; not current charges or usage.

consumption.definition: Explicit printed usage quantity; do not derive it by subtracting meter readings.

tariff_rate.definition: Printed monetary rate per stated consumption unit; preserve that unit and rate tier in evidence.

previous_balance.definition: Printed balance brought forward before current-period charges.

arrears.definition: Printed overdue amount; not assumed equal to previous balance.

current_charges.definition: Printed charges for the current billing period only.

adjustment_total.definition: Printed signed bill adjustment amount; do not substitute credits or calculate a net balance.

credit_total.definition: Printed bill credit amount with its source sign; never infer it from previous payments.

late_fee.definition: Printed late-payment fee amount; not an inferred overdue balance.

payment_amount.definition: Printed bill payment amount; not current charges or amount due.

service_charge.definition: Printed document-level service charge; not a sum of all charge rows.

tips.definition: Explicit printed tip/gratuity amount; do not infer it from tender minus total.

jompay_biller_code.definition: Printed JomPAY biller code, preserved as text.

jompay_reference_1.definition: Printed JomPAY Ref-1, preserved as text including leading zeros.

jompay_reference_2.definition: Printed JomPAY Ref-2; not a copy of Ref-1 when unprinted.

biller_reference.definition: Separately printed biller/payment reference with its original label; not a duplicated bill number.

table_number.definition: Printed restaurant table identifier; not a utility account or order identifier.

order_number.definition: Printed restaurant/service order identifier; not automatically the bill number.

merchant_name.definition: Printed merchant issuing the receipt; carries no AP/AR inference.

merchant_address.definition: Printed merchant address on the receipt, distinct from customer information.

receipt_number.definition: Printed primary receipt identifier; not an original/refunded receipt reference.

receipt_reference.definition: Separately printed generic receipt reference, not a duplicate primary receipt number.

transaction_date.definition: Printed date of the receipt transaction, not refund, void, issue/upload or payment processing date.

transaction_time.definition: Printed local transaction time in HH:MM[:SS]; do not invent timezone or missing seconds.

branch_name.definition: Printed merchant branch/outlet name, distinct from merchant legal name.

branch_id.definition: Printed branch/outlet code; preserve leading zeros.

cashier_name.definition: Printed cashier/operator name; do not infer it from an operator code.

cashier_id.definition: Printed cashier/operator identifier, distinct from cashier name.

terminal_id.definition: Printed payment/POS terminal identifier, distinct from register identifier.

register_id.definition: Printed cash register identifier, distinct from terminal identifier.

original_receipt_reference.definition: Printed reference to an earlier receipt linked by a refund/void; not this receipt identifier.

refund_reference.definition: Printed identifier of this refund transaction, distinct from the original receipt reference.

void_reference.definition: Printed identifier of this void transaction, distinct from the original receipt reference.

refund_reason.definition: Printed explanation for a refund; no invented accounting categorization.

customer_id.definition: Printed customer identifier; not a loyalty reference unless explicitly identified as such.

loyalty_reference.definition: Legitimately available printed loyalty/member reference; do not infer customer identity.

total_sales.definition: Printed sales aggregate; distinct from receipt total and amount paid.

amount_paid.definition: Printed receipt payment amount; not inferred from payment method or total.

tender.definition: Printed amount tendered; may exceed total or amount paid.

refund_amount.definition: Printed monetary refund amount with original sign retained; not automatically negative total.

refund_indicator.definition: Boolean meaning of explicit printed refund wording; an unprinted indicator is not false.

void_indicator.definition: Boolean meaning of explicit printed void wording; an unprinted indicator is not false.

refund_date.definition: Explicit printed refund transaction date, distinct from original transaction date.

void_date.definition: Explicit printed void transaction date, distinct from original transaction date.

description.definition: Printed item or charge-row description in its own row/group, preserving multiline text.

quantity.definition: Explicit printed row quantity as an exact decimal string; not inferred by dividing totals.

unit_price.definition: Explicit printed price per stated row unit; not derived by dividing line amount by quantity.

line_total.definition: Printed row amount; preserve whether tax-inclusive in annotation notes.

item_code.definition: Printed item/SKU code, preserved as text including leading zeros.

unit.definition: Printed row unit of measure; not an inferred product category or currency.

tax_category.definition: Printed tax-category code/name for this item or tax breakdown; not inferred from the rate.

line_discount.definition: Printed item discount amount, distinct from document discount or item discount rate.

line_discount_rate.definition: Printed item discount percentage in percentage points.

line_tax.definition: Printed tax amount for this item, distinct from document/category tax.

line_tax_rate.definition: Printed item tax percentage in percentage points.

line_allowance.definition: Printed allowance amount for this item; not inferred from unit price and quantity.

line_charge.definition: Printed additional charge for this item, distinct from document charge total.

myinvois_item_classification.definition: Printed classification code for this invoice item; not a predicted MSIC/business code.

tax_exemption_reason.definition: Printed reason/code for exemption in this tax category; never inferred from zero tax.

tax_rate.definition: Printed percentage expressed in percentage points (6% -> "6").

taxable_amount.definition: Printed tax base for this category, distinct from document subtotal and tax amount.

tax_amount.definition: Printed tax amount within this repeated tax category, distinct from document tax and line_tax.

charge_category.definition: Printed category/reason for this charge or allowance row; preserve the label and sign.

charge_amount.definition: Printed signed amount for this charge/allowance row; category distinguishes an allowance from a charge.

attribute_name.definition: Original printed label of an additional attribute without an existing canonical key.

attribute_value.definition: Additional printed attribute text; do not use to bypass known typed keys.
